action.transformation:
$.payload[diff]
  ?
    {
      "payload": $.payload[diff].{
        "update": {         
            "sequence": diff.sequence,
            "productStrategyProcessId": diff.productStrategyProcessId,
            "code": diff.code,
            "description": diff.description,
            "productStrategyProcessStepTypeId": diff.productStrategyProcessStepType.id,
            "expectedDuration": diff.expectedDuration,
            "url": diff.url,
            "fileId": $exists(diff.file)
                        ?diff.file.id?
                          diff.file.id
                          :null,
            "color": diff.color,
            "productStrategyProcessBomId": $exists(diff.productStrategyProcessBom)
                                              ?diff.productStrategyProcessBom.id?
                                                diff.productStrategyProcessBom.id
                                                :null,
            "target": $type(diff.target)!="null"?$number(diff.target):null,
            "min": $type(diff.min)!="null"?$number(diff.min):null,
            "max": $type(diff.max)!="null"?$number(diff.max):null,
            "unitId": $type(diff.unit)="null"?null:diff.unit.id
        },
        "where": {"id": data.id}
      }
    }
  :
    {"payload": [{"update": {},"where": {"id": ""}}]}
